findings.title: Magic constant MAX_ATTEMPTS lacks justifying comment
findings.problem: MAX_ATTEMPTS = 1000 is used as an upper bound for retrying os.link() calls when archive names collide, but the rationale for selecting 1000 specifically is undocumented. Future maintainers cannot distinguish whether this is an empirically derived bound, a conservative estimate, or an arbitrary ceiling.
findings.fix_hint: add a comment explaining that 1000 is a safe upper bound for handling race conditions between archive_name selection and os.link()
findings.why_it_matters: Constants at module scope need justification so maintainers understand design intent and can adjust if requirements change
